impact: When /story is the first command in a session, the Step 0.5 guard's whitelist is interpreted as blocking all non-permitted MCP calls — including zug_get_context. Zug's session start gate gets deferred until after the guard resolves, meaning the AI responds without a behavioral frame. Fix applied in zug-rule.md: gate now explicitly runs parallel with the skill's first call, not after. Story skill could also note that always-on companion gates (any tool named in global rules) are whitelisted during Step 0.5.
resolution: Two-sided fix: (1) zug-rule.md Session Start Gate now explicitly requires zug_get_context to run in the same turn as the skill's first required call — parallel, not sequential (committed in 1d6d6f8). (2) story skill SKILL.md whitelist now includes item (e) — always-on companion gate calls declared in global rules are exempt and run in parallel with step 1. Both sides are now consistent.
title: story skill Step 0.5 whitelist displaces always-on companion gates (Zug)
